name: nxvim-edithost-treesitter
description: Build-time tooling for the wasm edit-host's syntax highlighter: vendors the tree-sitter runtime + per-language grammar .wasm + sanitized queries from the pinned devDependencies into ./vendor/ (scripts/gen-treesitter.mjs). The parent crate's build.sh runs `npm run build:treesitter` here and copies ./vendor/ into web/vendor/. Build-time only — the edit-host ships static assets and loads no runtime CDN.
